_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — adds the top-level 'Configuration' group that menu-layout.json relocates master-data/config pages (Fiscal Years, Cost centers/objects, Tax config, dunning/matching/reorder rules, cashflow policy, allocation keys, BBV-mapping, XBRL/SBR taxonomies, rates) into. Group id stays 'Configuratie' so existing menu-layout.json relocations keep resolving; only the display label is anglicized.
